name: Laberinto de Tilde
source: OSM: Entrambasaguas hamlet (Notion area); the maze itself is not in OSM
description: An outdoor hedge maze in Campoo, best combined with another outing in the area rather than a dedicated drive.
hours: Published opening 10:00–20:00; subject to weather. Check before travel.

name: Laberinto de Villapresente
description: A seasonal outdoor hedge maze near Santillana del Mar, easy to combine with a visit to the town.
hours: 2026: 28 Mar–12 Oct. Jul/Aug daily; rest closed Mon/Tue. Generally 10:30–20:00; last entry 19:00, earlier from 16 Sep.
booking: No reservation normally needed. Outdoor hedge maze; no umbrellas inside.

open.seasonNote: Open 28 Mar–12 Oct in 2026; closed Mon/Tue outside July and August

name: Parque de la Naturaleza de Cabárceno
source: OSM: Parque de la Naturaleza de Cabárceno
description: A large wildlife park in a former open-cast mine landscape near Santander. A full-day outing, with an annual pass worth considering.
hours: Year-round except 24, 25 & 31 Dec and 1 Jan; seasonal hours.
booking: 2026 tickets: adult €25/€35/€45; child 4–12 €15/€20/€25 depending on season. Annual Tarjeta Amigo: individual €80; family €170; Family Plus €200.

name: Zoo de Santillana
source: OSM: Zoológico de Santillana del Mar
description: A zoo just outside Santillana del Mar; a half-day outing that pairs with the town and its museums.
hours: Open every day from 09:30; official site currently states until 20:00 / dusk.
booking: Tickets at the zoo or online; check the current day tariff. Annual Club de Amigos: child 4–12 €50; adult €100; family up to 3 children €300.

name: Camaleño
description: The Liébana municipality at the foot of the Picos de Europa; it includes Fuente Dé. A day-trip idea in your Notion.

name: Mirador de Covalruyo
description: A viewpoint above the Asón valley in Soba, saved in Notion as a hiking/family idea.

name: Sendero adaptado del Río Bayones
source: OSM: Sendero Adaptado del Río Bayones (path)
why: Very short family nature walk with ten tactile interpretation panels about local flora and fauna.

hike.childSuitability: Very suitable: short, low-difficulty adapted nature trail; part of the route is conditioned/protected with a handrail.

name: Rasines — Ruta Verde: Parque Paleolítico, La Balsa y Cantera Arqueológica
source: OSM: Rasines municipality centre (no start in Notion)
why: Signed local route through Rasines linking the Parque Paleolítico, La Balsa and Cantera Arqueológica.

name: Rasines — Ruta Azul: Balconada de Cerreo
source: OSM: Rasines municipality centre (no start in Notion)
why: Signed local Rasines route to the Balconada de Cerreo.
